name: hermes-agent-runtime
description: Provenance pin for the on-host Hermes agent/gateway runtime that OpenBurnBar vendors as compiled bytecode (gateway/, plugins/, tools/, hermes_cli/, tui_gateway/, agent/). Security remediation C-5: makes the most security-sensitive host-side component auditable + verifiable instead of opaque .pyc.
hashDefinition: sha256 over the sorted list of 'path sha256(blob)\n' lines for every *.py file under vendoredSubtrees at pinnedCommit (see scripts/ci/verify-vendored-agent-source.sh).

pendingHardening.reason: Security remediation C-4 (agent command-guard hardening: secret-read/exfil gating, fail-closed tirith, smart-mode escalation) lands on branch security/agent-sandbox-hardening and is NOT in pinnedCommit 005cf0d86 (which adds the L2 gateway PoP v2 signer on top of cde04bb9a). Before beta, merge C-4 into ajnunezg/burnbar-gateway-e2ee, re-vendor, and update pinnedCommit + vendoredSourceTreeSha256 here.

auditNote: The shipping product currently vendors this runtime as .pyc with the .py source gitignored, so the AGPL corresponding-source archive (scripts/create-corresponding-source.sh) does NOT contain it. C-5 closes that by pinning the exact source commit + hash here and verifying it in CI (verify-vendored-agent-source.sh). For full reproducibility, the corresponding-source archive should also bundle the pinned source tree.
